name: create_actionable_tasks_from_text
description: Extracts actionable items from a piece of text (meeting notes, a transcript) and creates a task for each one.

arguments.name: text
arguments.description: The text to extract action items from.

returns.name: work_ids
returns.description: IDs of the tasks that were created.

examples: Create action items from this transcript
Turn these meeting notes into tasks
